name: Payment attempts
description: Payments initiated in the day, any outcome.
formula: Count of payment records created on the day (Nairobi), across all charge types of the platform.
decision: Shows demand per product line; a drop with stable users points to a checkout problem.

name: Successful payments
description: Initiated payments that completed successfully.
formula: Count of initiated payments whose status is success.
decision: Baseline for revenue trend and success rate.

name: Failed payments
description: Initiated payments that ended in failure.
formula: Count of initiated payments whose status is failed (charge.failed or equivalent).
decision: Investigate provider or UX issues; contact affected customers.

name: Stuck pending payments
description: Payments still pending long after initiation (abandoned prompts or missed webhooks).
formula: Count of initiated payments still pending more than 30 minutes after initiation, at compute time.
decision: Reconcile against Paystack; a spike suggests missed webhooks.

name: Payment success rate
description: Share of initiated payments that succeeded (checkout conversion).
formula: success / attempts x 100. Abandoned prompts count as unsuccessful.
decision: Fix payments before spending on acquisition.

name: GMV (money charged)
description: Gross money charged to payers on successful payments, including gateway fees and money that belongs to customers.
formula: Sum of the gross amount charged on successful payments. Not company revenue.
decision: Scale of money moving through the platforms.

name: Gateway fees
description: Paystack fees on successful payments where recorded.
formula: Sum of recorded Paystack fees on successful payments. Chama top-ups, plans and reports do not record fees and add 0.
decision: Cost of collecting; input for pricing.

name: Platform revenue
description: What the company earns on successful payments before gateway costs and pass-throughs.
formula: PMS rent: commission cut. Cyber: platform commission. SMS / reports / plans / subscriptions: amount sold. Chama member payments: our fee (markup).
decision: Real size of the business by revenue stream.

name: Pass-through (agent share)
description: Portion of billed revenue owed onward, currently the agent share on PMS subscriptions.
formula: 45% of (gross - gateway fee) on PMS subscriptions that carry an agent.
decision: Cost of the agent channel.

caveat: Part of this rests on estimates; see "Net revenue not fully verified".
name: Net revenue
description: Company revenue after gateway costs it bears and pass-throughs.
formula: SMS and report sales: amount received after Paystack fee. Subscriptions: (gross - fee) less agent share. Rent commission, Cyber commission, Chama markup: the commission itself. Chama SMS / plan / report sales: amount sold (fee not recorded).
decision: Whether growth is profitable.

caveat: Rent commission derived from a rate, or sales whose gateway fee is not recorded.
name: Net revenue not fully verified
description: Part of net revenue that rests on an estimate: rent commission derived from tier rate, or gateway fee not recorded.
formula: Net revenue from payments whose basis is rate_estimate or gross_fee_unknown.
decision: Shrink to zero by recording actual split/fee amounts at source.

name: PAY running counters (snapshot)
description: Daily snapshot of the running totals PAY keeps in platform_stats/totals, which have no history of their own.
formula: Value of one platform_stats/totals field at snapshot time. Dimensions: db (default|register) and counter (field name). Revenue counters are in KES, not cents.
decision: Reconciliation check for the adapters; history for trends.

name: New schools
description: Schools that signed up on the day.
formula: Count of school records created on the day (Nairobi).
decision: Acquisition pace; compare with term-start dates.

name: New students
description: Student records created on the day (imports create many at once).
formula: Count of student records created on the day (Nairobi).
decision: Spot large imports and term-start load.

name: Schools (total)
description: Schools registered at snapshot time.
formula: Count of school records at 23:55 Nairobi.
decision: Size of the customer base.

name: Teacher accounts
description: User accounts with the teacher role at snapshot time.
formula: Count of users with role teacherAdmin at 23:55 Nairobi.
decision: Teachers per school shows how deeply schools have rolled out.

name: School admin accounts
description: User accounts with the school admin role at snapshot time.
formula: Count of users with role schoolAdmin at 23:55 Nairobi.
decision: Cross-check against schools total.

name: Active students
description: Students on the books (not graduated or archived) at snapshot time.
formula: Count of student records minus those flagged archived, at 23:55 Nairobi.
decision: Base for SMS volume; drives token demand.

name: Unspent SMS tokens
description: Prepaid tokens held by all users and not yet used: customers' unspent credit.
formula: Sum of messageTokens across all users at 23:55 Nairobi (includes tokens allocated to teachers).
decision: Sold-but-unused credit; a pile that keeps growing means schools buy but do not send.

name: Scheduled messages waiting for tokens
description: Scheduled messages stalled because the funding account ran out of tokens.
formula: Count of scheduled messages with status insufficientTokens at 23:55 Nairobi.
decision: Each one is a school ready to pay: contact them for a top-up.

name: Registers marked by teachers
description: Class registers a teacher actually saved for the day.
formula: Count of register records for the school day with locked = true.
decision: Core product usage.

name: Registers left unmarked
description: Classes nobody marked by noon; the system wrote a placeholder.
formula: Count of register records for the school day written by the system and never marked by a teacher.
decision: Schools with repeated unmarked classes need onboarding help.

name: Register marking rate
description: Share of the day's registers that a teacher marked.
formula: Marked registers / all register records for the school day x 100. Classes that are marked late still count once marked (recomputed nightly).
denominatorDesc: All register records for the day
decision: Falling rate means teachers are dropping the habit.

name: Students attended
description: Students marked present or late, in teacher-marked registers.
formula: Sum of present + late across marked registers for the school day.
decision: Volume behind attendance rate.

name: Students absent
description: Students marked absent, in teacher-marked registers.
formula: Sum of absent across marked registers for the school day.
decision: Drives absence SMS volume to parents.

name: Students excused
description: Students marked excused, in teacher-marked registers.
formula: Sum of excused across marked registers for the school day.
decision: Completes the attendance picture.

name: Attendance rate
description: Share of marked students who attended.
formula: (present + late) / (present + late + absent + excused) x 100, marked registers only; unmarked students excluded.
decision: Sanity check on data quality; implausible values mean misuse.

name: Active schools (marking)
description: Distinct schools with at least one teacher-marked register in the period. The headline adoption number.
formula: Distinct schools with a marked register (locked = true) on any school day in the period. Daily, weekly (Mon-Sun) and calendar-month values.
decision: Real adoption versus sign-ups; the gap is your onboarding backlog.

name: Active schools (messaging)
description: Distinct schools that sent at least one SMS in the period.
formula: Distinct schools with a message recorded as sent or partial in the period. Daily, weekly and monthly values.
decision: Only messaging schools consume tokens: this is the revenue-relevant base.

name: Schools buying tokens
description: Distinct schools with at least one successful SMS top-up in the period.
formula: Distinct schools with a successful top-up initiated in the period. Daily, weekly and monthly values.
decision: Compare with messaging schools to see conversion and repeat buying.

name: Messages sent
description: Messages that went out (sent or partially sent).
formula: Count of message records with status sent or partial (includes scheduled sends).
decision: Product usage beyond attendance.

name: Messages failed
description: Messages that failed for reasons other than running out of tokens.
formula: Count of message records with status failed that are not token blocks.
decision: Investigate provider or data problems.

caveat: Inferred from the failed-with-zeros signature; no stored flag.
name: Sends blocked: no tokens
description: Automatic attendance messages that could not go out because the sender had too few tokens (inferred).
formula: Count of failed message records with zero segments, zero tokens used and zero delivered: the signature of the app's insufficient-tokens block. Inferred, not a stored flag.
decision: Each is a school that wanted to send and could not: your best top-up nudge list.

name: Message success rate
description: Share of messages that reached the provider that were fully sent.
formula: sent / (sent + partial + failed) x 100. Token blocks are excluded (they never reached the provider).
denominatorDesc: Messages sent, partial or failed (not blocked)
decision: Falling rate points at provider, phone-number or content problems.

name: SMS recipients
description: Parent or teacher recipients reached by sent and partial messages.
formula: Sum of delivered (falling back to recipient count) over messages with status sent or partial.
decision: Volume behind token consumption.

caveat: Estimate: tokens are deducted and logged by the browser.
name: Tokens used
description: Tokens deducted for messages recorded on the day. An estimate: deduction and logging happen in the browser.
formula: Sum of tokensUsed over all message records for the day.
decision: Burn rate; pair with tokens sold to predict top-ups.

name: Scheduled messages sent
description: Messages sent by the scheduler rather than manually.
formula: Count of sent or partial message records that carry a scheduleId.
decision: Adoption of the automation feature.

name: Provider calls accepted
description: Send calls the SMS provider accepted (server log; acceptance, not handset delivery).
formula: Count of server SMS log records with status sent.
decision: Independent of the browser-written message log.

name: Provider calls failed
description: Send calls the SMS provider rejected or that errored.
formula: Count of server SMS log records with status failed.
decision: Spikes mean credentials, balance or provider trouble: check the provider first.

name: Provider success rate
description: Share of provider calls that were accepted.
formula: sent / (sent + failed) x 100 over the server SMS log. Pending calls are excluded.
decision: Operational health of the SMS channel.

name: Tokens sold
description: SMS tokens bought on successful top-ups (money is in the PAY KPIs).
formula: Sum of tokens on successful top-ups initiated on the day.
decision: Volume behind SMS revenue; compare with tokens used.

name: New chamas
description: Chamas created on the day.
formula: Count of chama records created on the day (Nairobi).
decision: Acquisition pace.

name: New members
description: Member records added on the day.
formula: Count of member records created on the day across all chamas.
decision: Network growth inside existing chamas.

name: Contribution volume
description: Contributions received into chamas.
formula: Sum of amount on ledger rows of type contribution (money in).
decision: Core money handled by the product.

name: Contributions received
description: Number of contribution payments.
formula: Count of ledger rows of type contribution.
decision: Activity behind the volume.

name: Loan repayments
description: Loan repayments received.
formula: Sum of amount on ledger rows of type loan_repayment.
decision: Loan book cash flow.

name: Loans disbursed
description: Loan money paid out to members.
formula: Sum of amount on ledger rows of type loan_disbursement.
decision: Lending appetite versus repayments.

name: Merry-go-round contributions
description: Contributions into merry-go-round pots.
formula: Sum of amount on ledger rows of type mgr_contribution.
decision: Adoption of the MGR feature.

name: Merry-go-round payouts
description: Pot money paid out to members.
formula: Sum of amount on ledger rows of type mgr_payout.
decision: Cross-check against MGR contributions.

name: Total money in
description: All money received into chamas (contributions, repayments, MGR).
formula: Sum of amount on ledger rows with direction in.
decision: Headline money handled.

caveat: Rows with no payment method count as not digital.
name: Digital payment share
description: Share of money in that was paid through the platform (Paystack) rather than recorded manually.
formula: Money in with method paystack / all money in x 100. Manual recordings earn the company nothing.
decision: The monetisable share of volume; raise it by pushing members to pay in-app or via WhatsApp.

name: WhatsApp payment share
description: Share of digital payments initiated on WhatsApp.
formula: Paystack money-in rows with channel whatsapp / all Paystack money-in rows x 100.
decision: Channel mix for product and support focus.

name: Active chamas (money)
description: Distinct chamas with at least one ledger transaction in the period. The headline adoption number.
formula: Distinct chamas with any ledger row created in the period. Daily, weekly (Mon-Sun) and calendar-month values.
decision: Real adoption versus sign-ups.

name: Active chamas (SMS)
description: Distinct chamas that sent an SMS in the period.
formula: Distinct chamas with an SMS log entry in the period. Daily, weekly and monthly values.
decision: SMS users are the revenue-relevant base for credits.

name: SMS campaigns sent
description: Bulk SMS sends from chamas.
formula: Count of SMS log entries.
decision: Feature usage.

name: SMS delivered to provider
description: Recipients the provider accepted.
formula: Sum of sentCount over SMS log entries (acceptance, not handset delivery).
decision: Volume behind credit use.

name: SMS credits used
description: Credits spent on SMS.
formula: Sum of creditsUsed over SMS log entries.
decision: Burn rate; pair with credits sold (PAY) to predict top-ups.

name: SMS acceptance rate
description: Share of intended recipients the provider accepted.
formula: sentCount / recipientCount x 100 over SMS log entries.
decision: Falling rate points at bad numbers or provider trouble.

name: Chamas (total)
description: Chamas registered at snapshot time.
formula: Count of chama records.
decision: Size of the customer base.

name: Chamas by plan
description: Chamas per subscription plan at snapshot time.
formula: Count of chamas with each plan value. Dimension: plan (free, starter, basic, growth, max).
decision: Conversion from Free to paid; plan mix.

caveat: Plan expiry is a UTC date; Nairobi is 3 hours ahead.
name: Plans expiring within 14 days
description: Chamas whose plan expiry falls in the next 14 days.
formula: Count of chamas with planExpiry from today through 14 days ahead.
decision: Renewal outreach list; unrenewed ones are downgraded to Free.

name: Active members
description: Members with active status across all chamas.
formula: Count of member records with status active.
decision: Size of the user base.

name: Unspent SMS credits
description: Prepaid SMS credits held by chamas.
formula: Sum of smsCredits across chamas.
decision: Sold-but-unused credit.

name: Unspent report credits
description: Prepaid report credits held by chamas.
formula: Sum of reportCreditsBalance across chamas.
decision: Sold-but-unused credit.

name: Open loans
description: Disbursed loans still being repaid (active or overdue).
formula: Count of loans with status active or overdue.
decision: Size of the loan book.

name: Loan book outstanding
description: Unpaid installments across open loans.
formula: Sum over open loans of (installment due - paid) for installments not marked paid.
decision: Money out on loan across chamas.

name: Loans past due
description: Open loans with at least one installment past its due date.
formula: Count of open loans with an unpaid installment whose due date is before today (Nairobi).
decision: Chamas needing a repayment follow-up.

name: Loan balance at risk
description: Outstanding balance of loans that are past due.
formula: Sum of outstanding balance over loans counted in loans past due.
decision: Size of the repayment problem.

name: Portfolio at risk
description: Share of the loan book that is past due.
formula: Balance at risk / loan book outstanding x 100.
decision: Health of customers' lending; rising PAR means chamas are struggling.

name: Overdue contributions
description: Contribution periods flagged overdue.
formula: Count of contribution records with status overdue (set by the nightly sweep).
decision: Collection health.

name: Overdue contribution amount
description: Unpaid part of overdue contributions.
formula: Sum of (amount - paidAmount) over overdue contributions.
decision: Money chamas are owed by their members.

name: Chamas with overdue contributions
description: Chamas that have at least one overdue contribution.
formula: Distinct chamas with an overdue contribution.
decision: Chamas that may need reminders or support.

name: Active merry-go-round pots
description: Pots currently running.
formula: Count of MGR pots with status active.
decision: Adoption of the MGR feature.

name: MGR pending shortfall
description: Amount active pots fell short by and have not covered.
formula: Sum of pendingShortfall over active MGR pots.
decision: Pots needing treasurer action.

name: Open MGR arrears
description: Member arrears still open in active pots.
formula: Count of arrears with status open across active pots.
decision: Members behind on pot contributions.

name: Open MGR arrears amount
description: Unsettled arrears amount in active pots.
formula: Sum of (amount - settledAmount) over open arrears in active pots.
decision: Money owed into pots.

caveat: As of last sync: accounts count once they reach the cloud.
name: New property managers
description: PMS accounts created on the day.
formula: Count of PMS user records created on the day (Nairobi). Counted when the account reaches the cloud.
decision: Acquisition pace.

name: Trials started
description: Free trials granted on the day.
formula: Count of users whose trialStartedAt falls on the day.
decision: Top of the conversion funnel.

name: New properties
description: Properties added on the day (as synced).
formula: Count of property records with createdAt on the day.
decision: Depth of adoption per manager.

name: New tenants
description: Tenants added on the day (as synced).
formula: Count of tenant records with createdAt on the day.
decision: Growth of the managed base.

caveat: As of last sync; recent days rise as devices sync.
name: Invoices issued
description: Rent invoices created on the day (as synced).
formula: Count of invoice records with createdAt on the day.
decision: Core product usage.

caveat: As of last sync; recent days rise as devices sync.
name: Amount invoiced
description: Total value of invoices issued (rent plus utilities and charges).
formula: Sum of totalAmount over invoices created on the day.
decision: Rent flow managed through the product.

caveat: As of last sync; recent days rise as devices sync.
name: Payments recorded
description: Rent payments recorded against invoices (manual or Paystack).
formula: Count of payment records with paymentDate on the day.
decision: Collection activity.

caveat: As of last sync; recent days rise as devices sync.
name: Rent collected (recorded)
description: Rent money recorded as received by managers, whatever the method. Tenant money, not company revenue.
formula: Sum of amount over payment records with paymentDate on the day. Compare with PAY rent GMV to see the digital share.
decision: Total rent handled; the gap to Paystack rent is the monetisable opportunity.

caveat: As of last sync; recent periods rise as devices sync.
name: Active property managers
description: Distinct managers who issued an invoice or recorded a payment in the period. The headline adoption number.
formula: Distinct userId across invoices created and payments recorded in the period. Daily, weekly (Mon-Sun) and calendar-month values; later syncs raise recent periods.
decision: Real adoption versus sign-ups.

name: PMS accounts (total)
description: PMS accounts in the cloud at snapshot time.
formula: Count of user records that carry a PMS localId.
decision: Size of the customer base.

name: Accounts by tier
description: PMS accounts per subscription tier.
formula: Count of users with each tier value. Dimension: tier (free, low, business, enterprise; anything else is counted as other).
decision: Plan mix and upgrade pressure.

name: Accounts synced in 7 days
description: Accounts whose device synced in the last 7 days.
formula: Count of users with lastSyncTime in the 7 days before the snapshot.
decision: Live usage of the sync feature.

name: Active paid accounts
description: Paying managers with a subscription still valid.
formula: Users with storage true, not on a trial, and subscriptionExpiry in the future.
decision: Recurring revenue base.

name: Paid plans expiring in 14 days
description: Active paid accounts whose subscription ends within 14 days.
formula: Active paid accounts with subscriptionExpiry between now and 14 days ahead.
decision: Renewal outreach list.

name: Paid plans lapsed in last 14 days
description: Paid accounts whose subscription ended in the last 14 days and has not been renewed.
formula: Users with storage true, not on a trial, and subscriptionExpiry in the 14 days before the snapshot.
decision: Win-back list; early churn signal.

name: Paid accounts not syncing
description: Paid accounts with no sync in 7 days or never synced.
formula: Users with storage true whose lastSyncTime is missing or older than 7 days.
decision: Support before they churn; stale data also understates every PMS KPI.

name: Active trials
description: Trials still running.
formula: Users with isTrial true and subscriptionExpiry in the future.
decision: Follow-up list for onboarding.

name: Trials ending in 7 days
description: Running trials ending within 7 days.
formula: Active trials with subscriptionExpiry within the next 7 days.
decision: Conversion calls.

name: Expired trials not yet downgraded
description: Trials past their end date still flagged as trials (downgrade job runs weekly on Mondays).
formula: Users with isTrial true and subscriptionExpiry in the past.
decision: Explains apparent premium users; clears every Monday.

name: Trial to paid conversion
description: Share of accounts that ever had a trial and later paid.
formula: Users with trialStartedAt whose lastPaymentDate is on or after it / users with trialStartedAt x 100. All-time cohort.
denominatorDesc: Accounts that ever had a trial
decision: Onboarding and pricing effectiveness.

caveat: Balance as stored on the manager's account (users.tokens).
name: Unspent SMS tokens
description: Prepaid Plot Yangu SMS tokens held by managers.
formula: Sum of users.tokens across PMS users (PAY credits it on a top-up; the SMS functions spend it).
decision: Sold-but-unused credit.

name: SMS tokens used
description: Tokens charged for SMS sent from Plot Yangu (rent reminders, bulk messages, desk-sent messages), net of refunds for failed sends.
formula: Sum of tokensCharged over users/{u}/sms-sent-log records sent on the day.
caveat: Exact: written by the server at send time, not synced from devices.
decision: SMS demand and the cost side of SMS margin.

name: SMS accepted by the provider
description: Messages the SMS provider accepted (not proof of handset delivery).
formula: Sum of successCount over the day's sms-sent-log records.
decision: Messages actually sent.

name: SMS failed
description: Messages the provider rejected (tokens are refunded).
formula: Sum of failCount over the day's sms-sent-log records.
decision: Provider or phone-number data problems.

name: Properties (total)
description: Properties synced to the cloud.
formula: Count of property records.
decision: Managed portfolio size.

name: Active tenants
description: Tenants flagged active.
formula: Count of tenant records with isActive true.
decision: Managed households.

name: Units (total)
description: Rentable units synced to the cloud.
formula: Count of unit records.
decision: Capacity under management.

name: Units occupied
description: Units flagged occupied.
formula: Count of unit records with isOccupied true.
decision: Basis of occupancy.

name: Occupancy rate
description: Share of units occupied.
formula: Occupied units / total units x 100.
decision: Customer success signal; falling occupancy hurts rent collected and renewals.

name: Unpaid invoices
description: Invoices PMS has not yet marked paid, as synced. PMS marks an invoice paid once 40% or more of it is paid.
formula: Count of invoices with isPaid false (below the 40% paid threshold PMS uses).
decision: Collection workload for managers.

caveat: As of last sync; excludes invoices PMS already marked paid at 40%.
name: Rent outstanding
description: Unpaid part of invoices PMS has not yet marked paid (below the 40% paid threshold).
formula: Sum of (totalAmount - amountPaid) over invoices with isPaid false. Invoices that are 40-99% paid are marked paid by PMS and are not counted.
decision: Money tenants owe across the portfolio.

name: Overdue invoices
description: Invoices not yet marked paid that are past their due date.
formula: Count of invoices with isPaid false and dueDate before today (Nairobi).
decision: Arrears follow-up.

name: Rent overdue
description: Unpaid amount on invoices past due.
formula: Sum of (totalAmount - amountPaid) over invoices with isPaid false and dueDate before today.
decision: Size of the arrears problem.

caveat: As of last sync; a billing month matures as tenants pay.
name: Rent collection rate (billing month)
description: Share of a billing month's invoiced rent that has been paid so far. Emitted for the current and previous billing month.
formula: Sum of amountPaid / sum of totalAmount x 100 over invoices with billingMonth equal to the month. Dimension: month (YYYY-MM). Matures as tenants pay.
numeratorDesc: Amount paid on the month's invoices
decision: Core outcome for property managers; low rates predict churn.

name: WhatsApp messages received
description: Inbound messages the bot processed.
formula: Meter field inbound for the Nairobi day.
decision: Bot demand.

name: WhatsApp messages sent
description: Outbound messages the bot sent (replies and notifications).
formula: Meter field outbound for the day.
decision: Cloud API volume and cost driver.

name: WhatsApp sends failed
description: Outbound messages the WhatsApp API rejected or that errored.
formula: Meter field outboundFailed for the day.
decision: Spikes mean token, template or API trouble: fix first.

name: WhatsApp send success rate
description: Share of outbound messages accepted by the WhatsApp API.
formula: (outbound - outboundFailed) / outbound x 100.
decision: Operational health of the channel.

name: WhatsApp conversations started
description: New conversation sessions (a session ends after 30 idle minutes).
formula: Meter field sessionsStarted for the day.
decision: How often people come back to the bot.

name: Active WhatsApp users
description: Distinct people who messaged the bot in the period. The headline Cyber usage number.
formula: Distinct hashed-phone keys in the meter's users map over the period. Daily, weekly (Mon-Sun) and monthly values.
decision: Real usage; compare with Cyber sign-ups.

caveat: Approximate: each phone counts once, at its latest activity.
name: WhatsApp users seen (approx.)
description: Phones whose latest session activity falls on the day. Understates: a returning user moves to a later day.
formula: Count of whatsapp_sessions documents with lastActive on the day. Approximate; superseded by active users once the meter is live.
decision: Directional usage before the meter exists.

caveat: Approximate: one session document per phone.
name: WhatsApp users known (approx.)
description: Distinct phones with a session document at snapshot time.
formula: Count of whatsapp_sessions documents at 23:55 Nairobi. Documents are overwritten per phone, so this approximates distinct recent users.
decision: Rough size of the WhatsApp audience.

name: Shops registered
description: Shops set up through the bot.
formula: Count of shops. Not collected yet.
decision: Size of the Cyber customer base.

name: New shops
description: Shops created on the day.
formula: Count of shops created on the day. Not collected yet.
decision: Acquisition pace.

name: Sales recorded
description: Sales logged through the bot.
formula: Count of shop sales. Not collected yet.
decision: Core product usage.

name: Sales value recorded
description: Value of sales logged through the bot.
formula: Sum of sale amounts. Not collected yet.
decision: Money passing through shops.

name: Expenses recorded
description: Expenses logged through the bot.
formula: Count of shop expenses. Not collected yet.
decision: Depth of usage.

name: Reports generated
description: Business reports produced.
formula: Count of completed report jobs. Not collected yet (report charges are already in the PAY KPIs).
decision: Feature demand.

name: Report jobs failed
description: Report requests that failed.
formula: Count of failed report jobs. Not collected yet.
decision: Reliability of a paid feature.

name: Desk agents
description: Agents on the network by status (applied, training, certified, active, suspended, closed). The total is every agent ever registered.
formula: Count of desk_agents at 23:55 Nairobi, in total and per status.
decision: Recruitment and activation funnel: many applied/training and few active means onboarding is the bottleneck.

name: Active desk agents
description: Agents allowed to work customer accounts today.
formula: Count of desk_agents with status active at 23:55 Nairobi.
decision: Capacity of the field network.

name: New agent applications
description: Agents who applied on the day.
formula: Count of desk_agents created on the day.
decision: Recruitment pace.

name: Customers owned by a desk
description: Chamas, schools and Plot Yangu landlords attributed to a desk agent. Attribution decides who earns commission.
formula: Count of desk_customers at 23:55 Nairobi, in total and per product (chama, school, pms).
decision: Reach of the agent network per product.

name: Desk customers that have bought
description: Desk-owned customers whose first qualifying purchase has been used.
formula: Count of desk_customers with firstPurchaseUsed true at 23:55 Nairobi.
decision: Conversion of attributed customers into paying ones.

name: Desk sessions started
description: Times an agent asked a customer for access to work on their account.
formula: Count of desk_sessions created on the day, in total and per product (from the entity key).
decision: How much hands-on support the network delivers.

name: Desk sessions verified
description: Sessions where the customer confirmed the access code.
formula: Count of the day's started sessions with otpVerifiedAt set.
decision: Sessions that became real work.

name: Session verification rate
description: Share of started sessions the customer verified. Low means codes are not arriving or customers refuse.
formula: verified / started x 100.
decision: Fix OTP delivery or agent briefing before blaming agents.

name: Agents working
description: Distinct agents who started a session in the period. The headline Desk activity number.
formula: Distinct agentId over desk_sessions created in the period. Daily, weekly (Mon-Sun) and monthly values.
decision: Compare with active agents: the gap is idle capacity.

name: Customers served
description: Distinct customer accounts with a verified desk session in the period.
formula: Distinct entityKey over verified desk_sessions in the period.
decision: Breadth of customers the network actually helps.

name: Service tickets quoted
description: Paid services an agent quoted (Excel import, manual entry, schedule setup, bulk reminder).
formula: Count of desk_tickets created on the day, in total and per serviceType.
decision: Demand for each paid service.

name: Service tickets paid
description: Quoted tickets the customer paid for (status paid or committed).
formula: Count of the day's created tickets with status paid or committed.
decision: Paid volume per service.

name: Ticket payment rate
description: Share of quoted tickets that were paid.
formula: paid / created x 100, by creation day.
caveat: Tickets still awaiting payment count as unpaid until they pay, so recent days read low.
decision: Pricing, STK problems or agents quoting before the customer agrees.

name: Paid tickets not yet committed
description: Tickets paid but whose work was not written to the product. Customer paid, nothing delivered.
formula: Count of the day's created tickets with status paid (not committed).
caveat: Normal for minutes after payment; a count that does not clear is a delivery fault.
decision: Chase immediately: money taken without the service.

name: Service tickets failed or expired
description: Tickets that failed or expired without payment.
formula: Count of the day's created tickets with status failed or expired.
decision: Payment friction on desk services.

name: Desk service sales (gross)
description: Gross charged for paid desk services.
formula: Sum of grossMinor (else amountMinor) of the day's paid or committed tickets.
caveat: The same money is already in the PAY KPIs as Cyber service charges: do not add the two.
decision: Size of the paid-services line.

name: Desk service revenue to Samuhia
description: Samuhia's cut of paid desk services after Paystack fees.
formula: Sum of platformMinor of the day's paid or committed tickets.
caveat: Already counted inside pay.net_revenue (Cyber); shown here for the desk view only.
decision: What the services line earns the company.

name: Sales through desk-owned customers
description: Successful charges on customers a desk owns (SMS, subscription, report, rent).
formula: Count of desk_events (not refunds) paid on the day, in total and per product and type.
decision: How much of the business flows through the agent network.

name: Desk-attributed gross sales
description: Gross value of charges on desk-owned customers.
formula: Sum of grossMinor of desk_events (not refunds) paid on the day.
caveat: A subset of pay.gmv, not an addition to it.
decision: Share of GMV the network influences.

name: Paid to agents by split
description: The agents' automatic Paystack split on those charges: their share of gross minus the real fee, rounded down.
formula: Sum of floor((grossMinor - feeMinor) x agentSharePct) per desk_event (not refunds).
caveat: Recomputed from the event the way PAY's split computes it. pay.net_revenue does not subtract this.
decision: Cost of the agent network; compare with revenue it brings.

name: Net kept by Samuhia on desk sales
description: What Samuhia keeps from desk-attributed charges after the Paystack fee and the agents' split.
formula: Sum of (grossMinor - feeMinor) minus the agent share, per desk_event (not refunds).
decision: True margin on agent-sourced sales.

name: Desk-attributed refunds
description: Refund events on desk-owned customers; agent commission on these is reversed.
formula: Count of desk_events of type refund paid on the day.
decision: Quality of agent-sourced sales.

name: SMS credits sold through desks
description: SMS credits or tokens bought by desk-owned customers.
formula: Sum of credits on the day's sms_purchase desk_events.
decision: SMS demand coming through agents.

name: Agent earnings recorded
description: Everything credited to agents on the day: service shares, commissions, bonuses, support pay (void entries excluded).
formula: Sum of desk_ledger amountMinor created on the day, excluding status void and kind reversal. Dimension kind = service, commission, bonus, support.
decision: Cost of the network and each way agents earn.

name: Commission reversals
description: Earnings clawed back (refunds).
formula: Sum of absolute desk_ledger amountMinor of kind reversal created on the day.
decision: Refund leakage on agent commissions.

name: Agent payouts waiting
description: Bonuses and support pay approved but not yet paid by the top desk.
formula: Sum of desk_ledger amountMinor with status payable at 23:55 Nairobi.
decision: Cash the top desk must release; late payouts lose agents.

name: Payout transfers in flight
description: Paystack transfers created but not confirmed.
formula: Count of desk_ledger entries with status processing at 23:55 Nairobi.
caveat: A count that stays above zero for days means a transfer never confirmed.
decision: Reconcile against Paystack Transfers.

name: Support visits logged
description: Support visits an agent logged for a customer.
formula: Count of desk_support created on the day, in total and per category.
decision: What customers need help with.

name: Support visits confirmed
description: Logged visits the customer confirmed with the SMS code.
formula: Count of the day's logged visits with customerConfirmedAt set.
decision: Only confirmed visits are payable: this is the trustworthy number.

name: Support confirmation rate
description: Share of logged visits the customer confirmed.
formula: confirmed / logged x 100.
caveat: Recent days read low until customers confirm.
decision: A low rate suggests logging without real visits.

name: Customer help requests
description: Requests sent to desks from Chama, Register or desks themselves.
formula: Count of desk_requests created on the day, in total and per source (chama, school, desk).
decision: Support load by product.

name: Help requests answered
description: Requests created on the day that now have status answered or closed.
formula: Count of the day's created desk_requests with status answered or closed.
caveat: Recent days rise as desks answer.
decision: Whether customers get an answer.

name: Help requests waiting
description: Requests nobody has answered yet (new) or that are being worked (open).
formula: Count of desk_requests with status new or open at 23:55 Nairobi; the total is new + open.
decision: Backlog: staff the top desk when it grows.

name: Rent STK batches
description: Batches in which an agent asked tenants to pay rent by STK push.
formula: Count of desk_rent_batches created on the day.
decision: Use of the desk rent-collection service.

name: Rent STK prompts sent
description: Tenant payment prompts delivered by desk batches.
formula: Count of results with status sent across the day's desk_rent_batches.
decision: Volume of desk-driven rent collection.

name: Rent STK prompts failed
description: Tenant prompts that could not be sent.
formula: Count of results with status failed across the day's desk_rent_batches.
decision: Fix tenant phone data or STK issues.

name: Payment attempts (company)
description: Payments initiated across all platforms.
formula: Sum of pay.attempts across platforms.
decision: Overall demand.

name: Successful payments (company)
description: Successful payments across all platforms.
formula: Sum of pay.success across platforms.
decision: Overall volume.

name: Payment success rate (company)
description: Company-wide checkout conversion.
formula: Sum of successes / sum of attempts x 100.
decision: Fix payments before marketing.

name: GMV (company)
description: Money charged across all platforms. Not revenue.
formula: Sum of pay.gmv across platforms.
decision: Scale of money moving.

name: Gateway fees (company)
description: Recorded Paystack fees across platforms.
formula: Sum of pay.gateway_fees across platforms.
decision: Cost of collecting.

name: Platform revenue (company)
description: What the company earns across all streams (commission, SMS, subscriptions, reports, markup).
formula: Sum of pay.platform_revenue across platforms. Dimension `stream` splits it by revenue stream.
decision: Real size of the business.

name: Pass-through (company)
description: Revenue owed onward (agent share).
formula: Sum of pay.pass_through across platforms.
decision: Cost of the agent channel.

caveat: Part of this rests on estimates; see "Net revenue not fully verified".
name: Net revenue (company)
description: Revenue after gateway costs and pass-throughs.
formula: Sum of pay.net_revenue across platforms.
decision: Whether growth is profitable.

name: Net revenue not fully verified (company)
description: Portion of net revenue that rests on an estimate.
formula: Sum of pay.net_revenue_unverified across platforms.
decision: How far to trust the net revenue figure.

name: Data freshness
description: Hours since each collector last succeeded. The number that tells you whether to trust every other number.
formula: Hours between now and the start of the collector's last successful run. Dimension: collector.
decision: If above 26 hours, a collector is failing: fix before reading any other KPI.

name: Active accounts
description: Active accounts
formula: Sum of the platform active-entity KPIs at the SAME grain: register.schools_marking + chama.chamas_active + pms.managers_active + cyber.wa_users_active (include a component only when a value exists for that period). One value per component with dimension platform in {register,chama,pms,cyber}, plus the total with no dimensions. Not de-duplicated across platforms (identifiers differ).
decision: Is the customer base across all products growing or shrinking, and which product drives it?
caveat: Entities differ by platform (schools, chamas, managers, WhatsApp users).

name: New accounts
description: New accounts
formula: register.schools_new + chama.chamas_new + pms.users_new, at the same grain; dimension platform in {register,chama,pms} plus total.
decision: Is acquisition healthy overall, and which product needs more sales or marketing effort?

name: Net revenue per active account
description: Net revenue per active account
formula: company.net_revenue (no dimensions) / company.active_accounts (no dimensions), at weekly and monthly grain only. value = round(numerator/denominator) in cents; numerator = net revenue cents; denominator = active accounts. Emit only when the denominator > 0.
decision: Are we earning more from each active customer, or growing usage without monetising it?

name: Unverified revenue share
description: Unverified revenue share
formula: company.net_revenue_unverified / company.net_revenue x 100, numerator and denominator stored; 0 when the denominator is 0.
numeratorDesc: Net revenue not fully verified (KES cents)
decision: How much reported revenue still rests on estimates, and which source should record real fees or splits?

name: Revenue share by platform
description: Revenue share by platform
formula: For platform P in {pms,register,chama,cyber}: pay.net_revenue (platform=P, no dimensions) / company.net_revenue (no dimensions) x 100. Dimension platform=P.
decision: Is revenue too concentrated in one product, and where should the next investment go?

name: Revenue share by stream
description: Revenue share by stream
formula: For stream S in {commission,sms,subscription,reports,markup}: company.net_revenue{stream=S} / company.net_revenue (no dimensions) x 100. Dimension stream=S.
numeratorDesc: Company net revenue of the stream (KES cents)
decision: Is the revenue mix shifting toward recurring streams or staying dependent on transaction fees?

name: Subscription revenue (recurring)
description: Subscription revenue (recurring)
formula: company.net_revenue{stream=subscription}: Plot Yangu subscriptions plus MyChama plans.
decision: Is predictable recurring income growing fast enough to cover fixed costs?

name: SMS units used
description: SMS units used
formula: register.sms_tokens_used (platform=register) + chama.sms_credits_used (platform=chama) at the same grain, plus a no-dimension total. Plot Yangu is excluded: its SMS consumption is not synced.
decision: How much SMS capacity are customers consuming, and does the provider bill need renegotiating?
caveat: Register tokens used is an estimate (deducted in the browser).

name: Prepaid SMS units outstanding
description: Prepaid SMS units outstanding
formula: register.tokens_outstanding + chama.sms_credits_outstanding + pms.tokens_outstanding (platform=register|chama|pms) plus a no-dimension total. Stock: weekly/monthly take the last daily snapshot.
decision: How large is the prepaid SMS liability we owe customers in future sends?

name: SMS provider cost (estimate)
description: SMS provider cost (estimate)
formula: cross.sms_units_used (no dimensions) x SMS_PROVIDER_COST_CENTS_PER_UNIT. Emit ONLY when that configured cost is > 0 (read from env KPI_SMS_COST_CENTS, default 0).
decision: What are we paying the SMS provider for the traffic our customers generate?

name: SMS margin (estimate)
description: SMS margin (estimate)
formula: (pay.net_revenue{stream=sms} for platform=register + same for platform=chama) - cross.sms_cost_estimate. Emit only when cross.sms_cost_estimate exists. Plot Yangu SMS revenue is excluded because its usage is unknown.
decision: Is selling SMS credits profitable, or should SMS prices change?
caveat: Needs the SMS provider cost per unit to be configured.

name: Digital rent share
description: Digital rent share
formula: pay.gmv (platform=pms, dimensions {chargeType: pms_rent}) / pms.rent_collected x 100. numerator, denominator stored. Share of recorded rent that was paid through Paystack. Emit only when pms.rent_collected > 0.
numeratorDesc: Rent paid through Paystack (GMV, KES cents)
denominatorDesc: Rent collected as recorded in Plot Yangu (KES cents)
decision: How much rent still bypasses our payment rail, and where is the commission opportunity?
caveat: PMS data is as of last sync.

name: Oldest data (hours)
description: Oldest data (hours)
formula: Maximum of company.data_freshness_hours (dimension collector) for the day. Day 'today' only matters.
decision: Is any dashboard number built on data too old to trust?

name: Collectors stale
description: Collectors stale
formula: Count of company.data_freshness_hours values > 26 for the day.
decision: Which data collectors have stopped running and need fixing today?
